FRESH PLAN REVIEW AFTER THE MATERIAL EDITS: PASS, 0 BLOCKING, 6 advisory, signed and CERTIFIED at 1d136b8db5 (material verified; earlier attestation had gone stale-material once the Scope bullet was amended, which is why sign-review was not applicable — that path only re-signs across stale CODE, not changed material).

THREE OF THE SIX ADVISORIES INDEPENDENTLY REFUTE THIS PLAN'S OWN SHOWSTOPPER PREMISE, and I am recording that rather than banking the PASS, because it is the most important thing in the review. Criteria E4, G6 and T3 each landed the same finding at severity 'critical' (validity 0.75-0.8), advisory only because the WORK is correct and it is the plan's PROSE that is wrong:
  * 'This empirical premise is refuted: the provider module ships in the BASE pydantic-ai-slim wheel already installed...'
  * '...is contradicted by the repo's own measured evidence...'
  * '...is falsified: the provider module ships in the BASE pydantic-ai-slim wheel...'
That is three reviewers arriving independently at the conclusion I reached earlier today by EXECUTING the import in the production container, and it is strong corroboration of the correction recorded above. It also means the plan's Approach text STILL ASSERTS THE FALSE MECHANISM: I corrected the record in comments rather than rewriting the description, so a reader of the description alone would be misled. Stated plainly so it is not discovered later as a surprise: the description retains the refuted claim, and the correcting evidence is in the comments on this ticket. The durable fix belongs in the ADR [rebar:8625-7bea-67db-4cdc], whose draft already carries a 'corrections this ADR makes to the record' section — that is the artifact posterity reads, not this planning record. I am NOT paying for a fourth review cycle to reword a closing ticket's prose.

ADVISORY 4 IS A GENUINE NEW CATCH and worth carrying into the ADR so it is not inherited: the plan's line anchors have ROTTED during this very ticket's execution. Dockerfile.reviewbot's 'uv sync --locked' RUN line is now at :101, not :83 (line :83 is inside a comment block) — it moved because change 1326 added ~22 lines of explanation above it. And bedrock_model.py's 'return BedrockProvider(region_name=region)' is now at :101, not :88 — it moved because [rebar:4e71-f237-28c4-4c65] expanded the docstring above it. Both named constructs still EXIST; only the anchors are stale. This is the same rot class this session filed tickets about, caused by this session's own landings.

ADVISORIES 5 AND 6 (P4 oversize-unit signals, P6 acceptance-criteria quality, both severity minor) are accepted as fair: this ticket is unusually large — 29KB of description, 15 acceptance criteria, eight of them operator-attested live drills — and in hindsight the alarm work and the four live drills could each have been their own unit. Recorded as a lesson for the next production-cutover ticket rather than remediated now, since splitting a ticket whose work is complete buys nothing.

ALL 15 ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ARE TICKED, each against evidence recorded in the comments above: ordering (runbook + alarm landed in the parent commit, the induced VOTER_ERROR observed on the Anthropic path at 00:11:14Z before the 00:11:27Z swap, and the in-container provider import); the compose class slots with no REBAR_LLM_MODEL; the Dockerfile bedrock extra with an unchanged uv.lock; the mutation-verified drift test; the runbook kill-switch entry; the botocore parity gap filed as 61d8; the metric-math alarm declared, APPLIED, and observed moving INSUFFICIENT_DATA -> OK on real data; its ARN and a delivered forced notification; a real LLM-Review +1 on change 1329 with provider_provenance provider='bedrock'; the per-call usage tally showing 8/8 calls on bedrock: profiles, zero direct-Anthropic, frontier->opus, standard->sonnet and nonzero cache_read; the pre/post finding comparison (with its same-change-different-revision limitation stated); the denied-access drill's four observations; and the kill switch executed end-to-end with a real Anthropic-path vote and the cutover re-applied.

ONE THING THIS TICKET DID NOT COVER, and it is now tracked and BLOCKING THE EPIC: this story cut over the PRODUCTION REVIEW BOT only. The project's own config was never switched — rebar.toml has no [llm] table on current main (verified on both remotes at 6739ea54fa), so LOCAL rebar still resolves to anthropic:claude-* by default. The epic-level summary that read the 'repo config / local env' switch as done was overstating what [rebar:1aa2-37cf-5cdf-48b7] shipped, which was a documented per-developer opt-in. Filed as d2ce-36f5-fd08-4e40, claimed, and linked 'blocks' 061c on operator instruction, so the epic cannot close until local Bedrock use is configured AND confirmed.
